'''Kharyrll Teleport''' is an [[Ancient Magicks]] spell, requiring 66 [[Magic]], that [[teleports]] the caster to [[Canifis]], near the bank, which is the modern location of what was once known as [[Kharyrll]]. As with all [[Ancient Magicks]], the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

Players who can cast this spell and who have 50 [[Construction]] can build a portal in the [[portal chamber]] of their [[player-owned house]] and direct it to Kharyrll. The required runes for the portal chamber are 200 [[law rune]]s and 100 [[blood rune]]s, which is 100 times the cost of casting the spell. Directing such a portal does not require the player's spellbook to be on Ancient Magicks.

Players who can cast this spell and who have 72 [[Construction]] can add the teleport to the [[portal nexus]] of their [[player-owned house]] and direct it to Kharyrll. The required runes for the portal nexus are 2,000 [[law rune]]s and 1,000 [[blood rune]]s, which is 1,000 times the cost of casting the spell. Directing the portal nexus does not require the player's spellbook to be on Ancient Magicks.

Entering a [[Kharyrll Portal]] in your [[POH]] is also a requirement for the [[Hard Morytania Diary]].
